notes: The corporate /careers URL returns 410; the company homepage links to its own Wix careers microsite https://www.ofbcareers.com/categories. The listing has four Wix CMS filter dropdowns ('By Functions' / Select Category, 'Filter Jobs' / Select Job Title, 'Filter by Job Function', 'Filter by Location') that filter the loaded collection client-side; the Wix Data query used by the adapter sends an empty filter object. No server-side filter parameter is exposed, so filters are applied locally.
